blocks.orig: Witness wildlife in their natural habitat
blocks.html: See wildlife in its natural surroundings

blocks.orig: Tanzania has an almost overwhelming amount of wildlife, and sometimes you don’t know where to look first. The elephant herds gathering at the waterhole, the cheetah outrunning everything and everyone, or the humpback whales performing a very special ballet. All of this makes a safari in Tanzania is an adventure in itself – no matter if on land or at sea.
blocks.html: The sheer quantity of wildlife in Tanzania can be almost overwhelming; at times you will not know where to look first. Elephant herds gathering at a waterhole, a cheetah outpacing everything and everyone, or humpback whales performing their own remarkable ballet. All of it makes a safari in Tanzania an adventure in its own right – on land as well as at sea.

blocks.orig: One of the great things about going on adventures in Tanzania is that there are so many unusual cultures to experience and learn about. For instance, you can explore the vibrant sights and sounds of the city of Arusha, visit the Kondoa rock paintings or experience the hospitality of the Iraqw.
blocks.html: One of the real pleasures of an adventure in Tanzania is the number of unusual cultures you can meet and learn from. You might, for example, take in the lively sights and sounds of the city of Arusha, go and see the rock paintings at Kondoa or enjoy the hospitality of the Iraqw.

blocks.orig: A Tanzania adventure tour usually requires far more involvement from you than a standard safari tour would. For instance, instead of sitting in the car, you can take a two-day hike from Ngorongoro to Lake Natron or get up close with dolphins or snakes.

blocks.orig: Who wants to be stuck in a car all day when there are so many other options to try on your Tanzania adventure? You can zip around in a Tuk-Tuk, go horseback riding in Arusha, or explore the crystal clear oceans in a semi-submarine.
